display.longDescription: 安装 Ubuntu apt 源里的 PCManFM，用来验证 Kite 的 SH/终端请求式 X11 渲染链路，也可作为轻量文件管理器使用。

requirementRows.label: 显示能力
requirementRows.value: SH 请求 Kite 内嵌 X11

recipe.cmd:
set -e
if ! command -v pcmanfm >/dev/null 2>&1; then echo 'PCManFM 还没有安装完整，请先点获取或重新获取。'; exit 127; fi
mkdir -p /workspace/.kf/runtime/pcmanfm-x11
proxy="${KITE_DESKTOP_PROXY:-/workspace/.kf/bin/kite-open-desktop}"
if [ ! -x "$proxy" ]; then echo 'Kite X11 桌面代理不可用，请重新打开实例。'; exit 127; fi
desktop_cmd='set -e
export KITE_X11_DESKTOP_WIDTH=${KITE_X11_DESKTOP_WIDTH:-1920}
export KITE_X11_DESKTOP_HEIGHT=${KITE_X11_DESKTOP_HEIGHT:-1080}
mkdir -p "$HOME/.config/pcmanfm/default"
config="$HOME/.config/pcmanfm/default/pcmanfm.conf"
if [ ! -f "$config" ]; then
  printf "[config]\nbm_open_method=0\n\n[volume]\nmount_on_startup=1\nmount_removable=1\nautorun=1\n\n[ui]\n" > "$config"
fi
for entry in "win_width=$KITE_X11_DESKTOP_WIDTH" "win_height=$KITE_X11_DESKTOP_HEIGHT" "splitter_pos=240"; do
  key="${entry%%=*}"
  if grep -q "^${key}=" "$config"; then
    sed -i "s/^${key}=.*/${entry}/" "$config"
  else
    printf "%s\n" "$entry" >> "$config"
  fi
done
if command -v dbus-launch >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  dbus-launch --exit-with-session pcmanfm --no-desktop --new-win /workspace &
else
  pcmanfm --no-desktop --new-win /workspace &
fi
app_pid=$!
if command -v xdotool >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  window=""
  i=0
  while [ "$i" -lt 80 ]; do
    window=$(xdotool search --pid "$app_pid" 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1 || true)
    if [ -z "$window" ]; then
      window=$(xdotool search --class pcmanfm 2>/dev/null | tail -n 1 || true)
    fi
    [ -n "$window" ] && break
    i=$((i + 1))
    sleep 0.05
  done
  if [ -n "$window" ]; then
    xdotool windowmove "$window" 0 0 || true
    xdotool windowsize "$window" "$KITE_X11_DESKTOP_WIDTH" "$KITE_X11_DESKTOP_HEIGHT" || true
    xdotool getwindowgeometry "$window" || true
  fi
fi
wait "$app_pid"'
"$proxy" "$desktop_cmd"
